title: Methods missing from the graph after a C# string with a quote in it
body:
**What I did:** in one of my C# files, a method contains `var q = @"""";` (a string holding a single double quote). I built the devkb graph.

**What I got:** none of the methods that come after that line in the file exist in the graph, and calls between them are missing. No warning.

**What I expected:** every method in the file, with its calls.
